english.title: Personal licence holder charged with an offence fail to produce licence at first court appearance - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a personal licence under the Licensing Act 2003 and having been charged with a relevant offence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFENCE..), prior to your first appearance before **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..) in connection with that offence, failed without reasonable excuse, to produce to that court your personal licence or notify that court of the existence of such a licence, the identity of the relevant licensing authority and the reasons why you could not produce the licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 128 of the Licensing Act 2003.
